title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.26419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. translated_title: 将复合材料世界模型与脉冲神经网络记忆模块集成到有限元（FEA）求解器中，用于缺陷与变异性的计算高效建模
translated_abstract: 每个纤维增强复合材料结构都具有独特的材料架构。所采用的制造方法以及缺陷的存在会导致局部变异，这要求材料尺度模型能够在结构中每个位置实时解析响应。并行多尺度方案可以提供这种能力，但由于积分点和时间增量的数量随结构尺寸增长，对于大型结构而言计算成本过于高昂。为缓解这些计算限制，代理模型作为材料尺度模型的替代品已被广泛研究。代理模型必须能够表示包含缺陷的任意局部架构，在未知数量的增量过程中追踪不可逆的材料状态，在由自身预测递归驱动时保持稳定，并适配每个积分点可用的内存。本文提出了一种基于多模态脉冲Transformer的复合材料世界模型……（摘要在此处被截断，仅翻译到可见部分）
tldr: 该论文将基于多模态脉冲Transformer的复合材料世界模型与脉冲神经网络记忆模块集成到有限元求解器中，实现了对纤维增强复合材料中缺陷与材料变异性的计算高效实时建模。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates a composite World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer with a Spiking Neural Network memory block into FEA solvers, enabling computationally efficient real-time modelling of defects and variabilities in fibre-reinforced composite structures.
